meta.originalInput: You think a five-second notification is harmless. But your brain does not just switch tasks and switch back. Every interruption leaves an invisible residue. One notification adds a tiny weight. Another leaves a fog. By noon, you are not doing deep work anymore. You are fighting through a wall of cognitive static. Single-tasking is not a discipline hack. It is defending the clarity of your mental space.
